info.name: AssayingAnomalies
info.summary: This library is a Python implementation of the MATLAB Toolkit that accompanies Novy-Marx and Velikov (2023) and is to be used for empirical academic asset pricing research, particularly focused on studying anomalies in the cross-section of stock returns.
